data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielau issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, resulting in a refund of €539.00 to be transferred to Johanna Beispielacker's account. She may file an objection (Einspruch) within one month of notification if she disagrees with the assessment.
data.explanation: This is the official decision from the tax office (Finanzamt) on your 2025 income tax return. Based on your income, deductible expenses (Werbungskosten) and special expenses (Sonderausgaben), you are owed a refund of €539.00, which the Finanzamt will transfer to the account on file automatically — no action is needed to receive it. If you believe the calculation is wrong (for example, how much of the childcare costs was recognised), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Beispielau; the app shows until when based on the deemed delivery date. If you do nothing by then, the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged. Consider professional tax advice if the figures seem incorrect.
data.tax_note: This document is itself the final income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025; keep it for your records as proof of the recognised Werbungskosten, Sonderausgaben and the refund received.

remedy.quote: Gegen die Festsetzung ist der Einspruch gegeben. Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielau ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
